# vendor/fonts

The display faces [`../../make-cd-image.html`](../../make-cd-image.html),
[`../../make-cassette-image.html`](../../make-cassette-image.html) and
[`../../quote-maker.html`](../../quote-maker.html) set their titles, their covers and
their quotes in. Thirty-one of them, named below as the pages list them.

They sat in `vendor/cd-image/fonts/` until the cassette tool turned up wanting most of
the same ones. Both tools came out of the same person's folders, so the overlap is not a
coincidence; one drawer beats two with fourteen files copied between them. The quote
maker is the third tool to open the drawer and the first that did not bring anything to
it, which is the point of having one.

## Where each came from

The twenty-five that came with the CD tool were `dl.dropboxusercontent.com` links in its
`@font-face` block, and the share id and key are kept so a missing one can be fetched
again. The six that came with the cassette tool were files in a Google Drive folder.

League Gothic was missing from the CD tool's set: its Dropbox share answers 403, because
its `rlkey` is 23 characters where every other one is 25, so the link was truncated or
revoked well before that port and the face had been falling back to a plain sans on the
original site too. The cassette tool's folder had the file, so it is here now and both
pages offer it.

Five more faces are offered in both pages and are not here, because they come from
whatever machine is looking at them: Arial, Impact, Courier New, Georgia and Verdana.

## Licences

These are third-party faces gathered for one person's own covers, and the repo is public.
Redistribution terms vary by foundry and none are recorded here; check each before leaning
on it for anything beyond personal use. League Gothic is the one known quantity: it is
SIL OFL.
